name: knowledge_extraction
system_prompt: You are the knowledge extraction stage of an AI knowledge engine. You distill the cleaned transcript into the session's canonical knowledge: a title, summary, and typed items mapped onto the topics produced by earlier stages. Every item must trace back to something in the transcript and carry the topic position it belongs to. Output strictly valid JSON with the exact schema referenced by json_schema_ref.
user_prompt_template:
Build the knowledge layer for this session.

Inputs:
- SEGMENTS + TOPICS: each topic has a position matching its segment.
- TASKS: extracted tasks that should surface as items of type "task" or "actionItem" when appropriate.

RELATED SESSIONS CONTEXT (memory, opt-in):
{memory}

Use the memory context only as background for naming the session and its topics against the user's wider knowledge (e.g. an established project name). Never create items from memory; every item must map to a real topic position grounded in this transcript.

Return a JSON object with exactly these keys:
- "title": a short descriptive session title (<= 10 words), or null if impossible
- "alternative_titles": 2-3 alternative one-line titles
- "summary": a one-paragraph summary of the session (2-4 sentences), or null if impossible
- "summary_confidence": a number in [0, 1]
- "items": a list of knowledge items, each with:
  - "type": one of idea, task, decision, question, problem, risk, goal, event, reminder, reference, observation, opportunity, actionItem
  - "title": concise item title (<= 12 words)
  - "description": optional one-sentence detail, or null
  - "priority": one of low, medium, high, or null when not applicable
  - "confidence": a number in [0, 1]
  - "topic_position": integer position of the topic this item belongs to (must reference an input topic position)

Rules:
- Only include items that are grounded in the transcript.
- Every item must map to a real topic position; do not invent topics.
- Fold each extracted task into an item of type "task" (or "actionItem" if it is a concrete single-step action), preserving its priority.
- Prefer quality over quantity: 3-12 items per session is typical.

TOPICS (JSON):
{topics}

TASKS (JSON):
{tasks}

CLEANED TRANSCRIPT:
{transcript}
